market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound with elevated volatility. Rising rate expectations and housing stress cap upside, while Pilbara commodity strength and healthcare rotation provide support. RBA commentary and housing data will dominate. Expect 1-2% index swings.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds in mining, renewables, and healthcare offset housing and consumer credit risks. If RBA navigates the housing inflation dilemma without a sharp hike, ASX 200 can grind higher. Political uncertainty from One Nation's energy and immigration policies adds a 6-12 month overhang.
